purpose: Complete the Multi-News secondary benchmark with a frozen official-test table plus final-architecture ablation and controlled cost evidence. None of these results may select or modify the method.

dataset_role.GovReport: primary confirmatory long-single-document benchmark; completed final test is unchanged
dataset_role.Multi-News: secondary multi-document benchmark with its own dev-frozen task profile and official final test

final_test.primary_comparison: proposed vs pacsum_tfidf_P08, selected as the strongest frozen-dev baseline before test
final_test.published_scale_secondary: Stanza tokenize,mwt plus Perl ROUGE-1.5.5, reported separately from internal rouge-score R-Lsum

paired_inference.secondary_adjustment: Holm over 8 comparators x 4 metrics = 32 endpoints

final_test.outcome_rule: Report all metrics and uncertainty. Macro superiority is supported only if delta, CI lower bound, and two-sided p all pass; failure does not permit tuning or rerun.

variants.A01_no_semantic: remove semantic while preserving graph x2 and total capacity 80
variants.A02_no_graph: remove graph while preserving lexical+semantic and total capacity 80
variants.A03_lexical_only_capacity_80: lexical-only route with route_top_k and total both 80
variants.A04_equal_rank_rrf: same fixed anchor candidate pool, replace graph x2 by equal route weights
variants.A05_index_only_lexical: same fixed anchor candidate pool, replace provenance fusion salience by lexical percentile

e3_final_architecture_ablation.claim_rule: A component claim is Multi-News-supported only when full-minus-ablation macro CI is positive and Holm-20 p <= 0.05. Unsuccessful claims are downgraded, not tuned.

e2_controlled_cost.decision_rule: Cost evidence is descriptive and cannot select a different system or alter quality claims.
